Q1 RESOURCE RULE: the resource is what the job reads or writes. web.export and web.publish of the open document admit on the open package's document id. Site-wide work (the site export, web.site_report, web.move_file) always admits on the site-derived SDOC id, package open or not, with Action Export, Read and Edit respectively. BridgeJobs (kernel-bindings adapter.rs:346-371) forwards any resource id. Whether the host accepts an id unknown to Folio is host-side and NOT_INSPECTED here; a host refusal returns overloaded with the long retry, which fails closed.
